command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP: ensure opsadmin user exists =="
if ! id opsadmin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n useradd -m -s /bin/bash opsadmin
  echo "created opsadmin"
else
  echo "opsadmin already exists"
fi

echo "== STEP: set up .ssh dir and authorized_keys =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /home/opsadmin/.ssh
sudo -n tee /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys > /dev/null <<'EOF'
ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAINMKA2+oNHxgmpABaV61Sar8lVW2YxSL8Aw9d7b5yLh1 os-comparison@example.invalid
EOF
sudo -n chmod 700 /home/opsadmin/.ssh
sudo -n chmod 600 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
sudo -n chown -R opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh

echo "== STEP: lock password auth for opsadmin (disable password login) =="
sudo -n passwd -l opsadmin || true

echo "== STEP: configure sshd for key-based auth cluster-wide =="
SSHD_CONF=/etc/ssh/sshd_config
sudo -n cp "$SSHD_CONF" "${SSHD_CONF}.bak.$(date +%s)"

set_directive() {
  key="$1"; val="$2"
  if sudo -n grep -qiE "^[#[:space:]]*${key}[[:space:]]" "$SSHD_CONF"; then
    sudo -n sed -i -E "s|^[#[:space:]]*${key}[[:space:]].*|${key} ${val}|I" "$SSHD_CONF"
  else
    printf '%s %s\n' "$key" "$val" | sudo -n tee -a "$SSHD_CONF" > /dev/null
  fi
}

set_directive PasswordAuthentication no
set_directive ChallengeResponseAuthentication no
set_directive KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
set_directive PubkeyAuthentication yes
set_directive UsePAM yes

echo "== STEP: validate sshd config =="
sudo -n sshd -t

echo "== STEP: restart sshd to apply =="
sudo -n systemctl restart sshd

echo "== STEP: verification =="
echo "--- id opsadmin ---"
id opsadmin
echo "--- authorized_keys ---"
sudo -n cat /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
echo "--- passwd status ---"
sudo -n passwd -S opsadmin
echo "--- sshd effective config ---"
sudo -n sshd -T | grep -iE '^(passwordauthentication|pubkeyauthentication|kbdinteractiveauthentication|usepam)\b'
echo "--- sshd active ---"
systemctl is-active sshd
echo "DONE"
